55129.story: Through Oct 9, the weather station in Spooner had 20.12 inches, 6.57 inches less than a usual year. April was the wettest month at 4.81 inches, and the biggest one-day reading was 2.25 inches on Jul 4. The gauge then went 19 days in a row with nothing in it, not even a trace, from Aug 2 to Aug 20. That is 5.64 inches less than 2025 had by Oct 9.
